paite: Huai lou in TOUPA'N Job adawng a, hichi in achi:
english: Moreover Yahweh answered Job,

paite: "Kuapeuh awlmoh nei lou in thil Bangkim hihthei akiselpih diam? Kuapeuh Pathian kiselpih, huai tuh amah dawngsak un."
english: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

paite: Job in TOUPA adawng a, hichi in achi:
heading: Job Thuphatawina
english: Then Job answered Yahweh,

paite: "Ngai in, bangmah ka hita kei a; bangchi in ka hon dawng dia? Ka kam ah ka khut ka koih.
english: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

paite: Khatvei ka pauta a, ka dawng kei ding; ahi, nihvei himahleh ka pau nawn kei ding.”
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

paite: Toupa'n pingpei a kipan in Job adawng a, hichi in achi.
heading: Pathian In Job Achouna
english: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind:

paite: "Kipasalsak inla, tu in na kawng gak in. Nang a kipan ka hon phut dia, kei kiang ah na hon puang ding hi.
heading: TOUPA' Thugen
english: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

paite: Ka vaihawmna bangmah lou a koih ding na hiam? Siam na tantheihna dia, kei hon mohpaih ding na hi hia?
english: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

paite: Ahihkeileh Pathian bang in ban na nei hia? Amah bang in aw in vanpi na gingsak thei hia?
english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

paite: Tu in nang hoihkim leh zahna in kizem in; zahna leh lalna in kivan in.
english: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

paite: Na hehna dimlette sungkhia in; michih kisatheite en inla, hihniam in.
english: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

paite: Michih kisathei en inla, kainiam in; adinna uah migiloute tuanchil in.
english: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

paite: Leivui ah amaute selkhawm in; mundai ah amai uh kan in.
english: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

paite: Huchi in na khut taklam in nang ahondam thei chih ka hon thei ding.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

paite: "Ngai dih, nang ka hon siam bang a ka siam, tu in behemoth en in; bawngtal bang in loupa ane hi.
english: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

paite: En in tu in, akawng ah ahatna a-om a, agilpi thate ah ahatna a-om hi
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

paite: Sidar sing bang in amei atangsak a, apheite thaguite phankhawm in a-om hi.
english: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

paite: Aguhte dal lawng ahi a, aguh leh tangte siktawn bang ahi.
english: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

paite: "Pathian lampite amakai lianpen ahi, amah bawlpa kia in anamsau amah kiang lam naih ding in abawl thei ding.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

paite: Chihtaktak in mualte'n amah an apuak ua; gamsate tengteng mawlna mun ah.
english: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

paite: Singbawk limte nuai ah alum a, pumpeng kawm leh chiknawng lak ah.
english: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

paite: Tui lili singte'n alim un akhuh ua; lui gei singnah kaite'n atuam kimvel uhi.
english: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

paite: Ngai in, lui adimletleh, aling kei a; akam chiang pha hial in Jordan khang mahleh, amuang hi.
english: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

paite: Akiven lai in kuapeuh in amah sikkawi in aman diam, thang in anak avut pailet diam?”
english: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?
